The main takeaway from our work is that
a primary intramedullly spinal tumour can be a metastasis of an occult intracranian tumour.
spinal metastasis from intracranial germ cell tumours can be seen in the absence of a detectable primary lesion.
a spinal intramedullary mass in the absence of a known primary intracranial tumour should prompt a thorough search for an occult intracranian primary.
